test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 5 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Given below are two statements and two conclusions. Take the statements to be true even if they are at variance with commonly known facts, and decide whether the conclusion(s) follow(s) the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All ovens are stoves.

II. No stove is a fridge.

**Conclusions:**

I. No oven is a fridge.

II. Some fridges are ovens.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn Diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8f9c076a7593312c61c70491784fbede27e5d80bb07aac4f6bc873a736221ed.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No oven is a fridge. → Follows (because all ovens are stoves and no stove is a fridge, hence no oven is a fridge.)

II. Some fridges are ovens. → Does not follow (because all ovens are stoves and no stove is a fridge, hence no fridge is an oven.)

Hence, “**Only conclusion I follows**”.
